answer: Every new agent locks a refundable 350 POA bond for twelve weeks and climbs a spiral of paid jobs, one, then two, then four, so a fake identity costs 350 POA plus seven real jobs. Each rung needs a different paying client, so a farm cannot run a thousand copies in parallel. Every finished job adds a plume to the public record buyers read before paying. Three auditors drawn by lot run whisper checks with no warning, and a failed check burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
